segments.mn132:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn132:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca bhāsati.
segments.mn132:2.2: Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenupaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.mn132:2.4: “ko nu kho, bhikkhave, upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsī”ti?
segments.mn132:2.5: “Āyasmā, bhante, ānando upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsī”ti.
segments.mn132:2.6: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn132:2.7: “yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsī”ti?
segments.mn132:3.1: “Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesiṃ samādapesiṃ samuttejesiṃ sampahaṃsesiṃ, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsiṃ –
segments.mn132:3.12: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.mn132:3.16: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate muni”.
segments.mn132:4.2: Evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti – evaṃ kho, āvuso, atītaṃ anvāgameti.
segments.mn132:5.2: Evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti, evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti, evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti, evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti, evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti – evaṃ kho, āvuso, atītaṃ nānvāgameti.
segments.mn132:6.2: Evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃvedano siyaṃ … pe … evaṃsañño siyaṃ … evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ … evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti – evaṃ kho, āvuso, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn132:7.2: Evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti, evaṃvedano siyaṃ … pe … evaṃsañño siyaṃ … evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ … evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti – evaṃ kho, āvuso, anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn132:8.2: Idha, āvuso, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
segments.mn132:8.4: vedanaṃ … saññaṃ … saṅkhāre … viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ – evaṃ kho, āvuso, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
segments.mn132:9.2: Idha, āvuso, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
segments.mn132:9.4: na vedanaṃ … na saññaṃ … na saṅkhāre … na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ – evaṃ kho, āvuso, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
segments.mn132:10.11: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.mn132:10.15: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn132:11.1: “Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesiṃ samādapesiṃ samuttejesiṃ sampahaṃsesiṃ, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsin”ti.
segments.mn132:11.3: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsi –
segments.mn132:12.3: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn132:13-19.1: “Kathañca, ānanda, atītaṃ anvāgameti … pe … evaṃ kho, ānanda, atītaṃ anvāgameti.
segments.mn132:13-19.3: Kathañca, ānanda, atītaṃ nānvāgameti … pe … evaṃ kho, ānanda, atītaṃ nānvāgameti.
segments.mn132:13-19.5: Kathañca, ānanda, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati … pe … evaṃ kho, ānanda, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn132:13-19.7: Kathañca, ānanda, anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati … pe … evaṃ kho, ānanda, anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn132:13-19.9: Kathañca, ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati … pe … evaṃ kho, ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
segments.mn132:13-19.11: Kathañca, ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati … pe … evaṃ kho, ānanda, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
segments.mn132:13-19.15: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn132:13-19.18: Attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Ko nu kho, bhikkhaveti jānantova kathāsamuṭṭhāpanatthaṃ pucchi.
Sādhu kho tvanti parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi parisuddhehi kathitattā desanaṃ pasaṃsanto āha.
Bahiddhā puthuttārammaṇato nivattetvā ekasmiṃyeva ārammaṇe cittassa sammadeva layanaṃ appanaṃ paṭisallānaṃ, yo koci samāpattivihāro, idha pana ariyavihāro adhippetoti āha –
Uḷārasundarabhāvamukheneva anāgatesupi rūpādīsu taṇhādiṭṭhikappanā pavattatīti āha –

Vattabbaṃ siyāti yathā nandiyā asamanvānayanajotanaṃ byatirekamukhena patiṭṭhapetuṃ,“atītaṃ na nvāgameyyā”ti uddesassa,“kathañca, bhikkhave, atītaṃ anvāgametī”tiādinā (ma. ni.3.273) vibhaṅgo vutto, evaṃ “paccuppannañca yo dhamman”tiādikassa uddesassa byatirekamukhena vibhaṅge vuccamāne vipassanāpaṭikkhepavasena,“kathañca … pe … vattabbaṃ siyā”ti vuttaṃ.

Tayidaṃ paramagambhīraṃ satthudesanānayaṃ anupadhāretvā coditaṃ, yasmā “paccuppannañca yo dhamman”tiādikassa uddesassa byatirekamukheneva vipassanāpaṭikkhepavasena,“kathañca, bhikkhave, paccuppannesū”ti vibhaṅgadesanā sampavattati.
Abhāvaṃ dassetuṃ saṃhīratīti mātikaṃ uddharitvāti kathetukamyatāya mātikāvasena paduddhāraṃ katvā,“idha, bhikkhave, asutavā sutavā”ti ca ādinā vitthāro vutto.

Vipassanāya abhāvatoti vipassanāya abhāvitatāya avikkhambhitatāya taṇhādiṭṭhīhi sapattehi viya tattha tattha ṭhapanāya ākaḍḍhīyati, tattha tattha visaye tato eva apāyasamuddaṃ saṃsārasamuddaṃ ānīyati.
